title: Parryblade
description: a custom parry based combat system
body:
run /function parry:give to obtain

adds a sword that is focused around a custom parry based system, double tap back to backdash, and hold right click to parry (when off cooldown)

missing a parry will slow and weaken you, getting parried will stun you, landing a parry cuts out most of the parry cooldown.

you cannot jump with the sword and it has a hit cooldown.
